description: Integrations (between two systems): Use after get_integration_health with include conflicts, once the person chose. choice sync makes the record that also matches the one the shared record follows from the next sync; choice keep_apart leaves both records as they are and stops asking. Both can be undone in CRM Connector. Ask the person to confirm first.

conflict_id.description: The id of the conflict, as get_integration_health returns it with include conflicts.

integration_id.description: The id of the integration, as list_integrations returns it. Ask the person which integration they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

name: resolve_integration_conflict
title: Resolve an integration conflict
